corbifollis, corbifollis m.

noun, third declension

From corbis “basket” and follis, the inflated ball. The game record follows the Vatican’s canistrum for the basket; Traupman builds on corbis.

Other words

  • follis canistrārius

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. basketball (cf. LRL canistrifollis)

    Morgan–Owens, after the Vatican’s follis canistrīque lūdus.

See also basketball, basket, ball.
